output.brief: Cancelling RotaWeave is not the fix. The drop is concentrated at Dock Street and Westgate, which have both the app and no coordinator. Millbrook has the app and a coordinator, and it is stable. Quarry Lane has no coordinator but no app, and it is also stable. The app alone or the coordinator cut alone doesn't produce the fall. Together they do. On the basic tier, a regular keeps a weekly slot only if staff book it before the Thursday release. Coordinators used to do that booking, and it fell from 74 a week to 3. Of the 213 April regulars at those two sites, 129 lost their usual slot at least twice. 88% of them are now inactive, against 11% of those who kept their slot. The callbacks match this. Background checks and Commonplate don't explain it: 121 of the 123 lapsed volunteers had a current check, and only 2 joined another group. Next steps: have staff or a lead volunteer pre-book regulars into their usual slots at Dock Street and Westgate, using the unused admin seat. Phone lapsed regulars to offer the slot back. Review after 60 days. Keep the renewal requirement, because the county contract and insurer require it. Don't purge the roster. My confidence is fairly high. The evidence is observational, and the callbacks reached only 61 people.
